thread:
eric: Hey team — can someone glance at PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/data-pipelines/pull/4823? It's a small rollforward for the events schema and a transformer change in ingestion to handle the new 'session_id' field.

maria: On it — what's the risk for backfills? Any migration window?

eric: No schema rewrite, just additive column + kafka deserializer change. Plan is zero-downtime: deploy consumer with defaulting, then migrate producers. Backfill script is included in the PR under /scripts/backfill_session_id.py

sam: Can you paste the migration SQL here?

eric: Sure:
```
ALTER TABLE events ADD COLUMN session_id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid();
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_events_session_id ON events(session_id);
```
Backfill uses batched updates with LIMIT/OFFSET to avoid long tx.

jackie: FYI @dba-team — index created concurrently but we'll still want to monitor bloat.

infra-ci-bot: CI passed — all tests green; staging deployment succeeded: https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/9482

maria: Quick code comment — in the consumer change, prefer try/except around the header parsing. Otherwise lgtm.

eric: Thanks — added exception handling and a unit test. PTAL

sam: Left one small nit about batching size in backfill script (1000 -> 500). If we reduce to 500 it's safer during peak.

eric: Updated to 500, pushed. Also added a migration-runbook section to the PR description with the rollout steps and rollback commands.

jackie: I can approve the infra side once you ensure the IAM role for the backfill job has read-only replica access.

eric: Confirmed — using replica role `etl_backfill`. Will run backfill during low-traffic window at 02:00 UTC.

maria: Approving from data-pipeline side. :thumbsup:

sam: Approving from DB side, but please monitor replication lag during index creation.

eric: Thanks all — merging after a 30-min quiet period. Will post updates in #incidents if anything spikes.

infra-ci-bot: Merge scheduled: https://github.com/redwood-inference/data-pipelines/pull/4823/merge

eric: merged. will kick off backfill tomorrow.

maria: cool, keep us posted. :eyes:
